# Venice, Building by Building — Full Documentation

## Project
- Live site: https://venice-by-building.vercel.app
- Repository: https://github.com/maximosovsky/venice-by-building
- Author: Maxim Osovsky

## What it is
A 3D atlas of the historic centre of Venice: every building drawn from its OpenStreetMap footprint, dated from the municipal VPRG classification and Italian Wikipedia, enriched with Wikidata and Commons photographs. Includes a timeline that assembles the city epoch by epoch.

## Scale
- 11,137 buildings (historic centre: Venice island, Giudecca, San Giorgio Maggiore, La Certosa, Murano, Burano)
- 465 bridges with municipal characteristics
- 1,536 buildings matched to Wikidata by geometry
- 1,082 buildings with Commons photographs
- 8,915 buildings with measured heights from 2010 topographic survey
- Trilingual: Russian, Italian, English

## Pipeline (pipeline/venice/)
All stages in order:
1. s01_buildings.py — OSM extract: buildings, parts, addresses, streets, water
2. s02_dating.py — Municipal VPRG classification + OSM dates → evidence table
3. s04_wikimedia.py — Wikidata labels, Wikipedia articles, Commons photos
4. s05_streets.py — Streets as ordered rows of facades
5. s07_wikidata.py — Wikidata items matched to footprints by geometry
6. s08_wikidata_enrich.py — Names, articles, dates, architects, styles, heritage, heights
7. s09_municipal.py — Measured heights from 2010 topographic survey
8. s10_itwiki.py — Construction dates from Italian Wikipedia prose
9. s11_media.py — Commons photos fetched, shrunk to 560 px WebP
10. s06_export.py — Tiles, packs, attributes, cards → viewer binary format

## Viewer (web/)
- Engine: SydMap by Amir Marashi (MIT), vendored unchanged except data path and wording
- Three.js r186
- Data contract: 600 m tiles in gzipped SYD2-format pack*.bin, 56-byte attrs.bin, wiki.json, names.json, heritage.json, labels.json, layers.json, land/water polygon bins
- Tests: web/tests/ — contract, i18n coverage, worker smoke, UI tests

## Data sources
- OpenStreetMap geometry, addresses, parts, street names (ODbL 1.0)
- VPRG Città Antica classification, Comune di Venezia (CC BY 4.0)
- Wikidata (CC0)
- Wikipedia text (CC BY-SA)
- Wikimedia Commons photos (per file, author and licence on each card)

## Documentation (docs/)
- viewer-contract_20261022.md — data contract implemented by s06_export.py
- vprg-classification_20261022.md — municipal class descriptions and state flags
- engine-analysis_20261022.md — comparative analysis of building atlas engines
- topographic-data-inventory_20261022.md — 1987–2010 topographic releases
- historical-data-inventory_20261022.md — 1740/1808/1857 registers + TimeMachine Atlas
- itwiki-dates_20261023.md — Italian Wikipedia date extraction methodology
- municipal-heights_20261023.md — height source methodology
- wikidata-enrichment_20261023.md — Wikidata geometric matching methodology
- bridge-route_20261023.md — bridge route construction
- church-route-contract.md — church route methodology
